owner_posts.post_text:
Astrology is more than just the 12 signs of the zodiac—it's a layered, multi-faceted tool for understanding ourselves & others. In this fascinating guide, you can discover what your sun sign says about you, who you are most compatible with romantically, & how you can progress in life with insights from the heavens above. More advanced ideas regarding aspects such as Mercury Retrograde, Moon Signs & other astrological terms are explained fully & permit the reader to begin their journey into this lifelong passion.

• Descriptions of all 12 signs
• Controversies about whether there is a 13th sign addressed
• Moon signs & their significance

This book is a wonderful companion for anyone wanting to align their life with the magic of the stars.

• Includes 36 full-colour cards featuring sacred icon-style paintings of threatened & endangered species & instructions for using this deck in a group setting
• Portrays the unique charism of each species, the challenges it faces, & how it affects the greater biological community & human health
• Teaches Visio Divina, or sacred seeing, an ancient form of prayer & meditation that evokes intuitive knowing & inspires meaningful action

Exploring the richness & necessity of biodiversity, this deck of 36 full-colour cards features the work of world-renowned artist Angela Manno & reveals how the loss of biodiversity is leading to the warming of our planet. She presents each threatened species in a traditionally religious form—the icon—to illustrate its true significance.

Rich with insights from geologian Thomas Berry & other ecological elders, the guidebook reveals the preciousness of each organism, specific challenges to its existence, & its effect on the greater biological community & human health.

Uniquely supported by QR codes leading to the websites of conservation organisations working to protect each species & its habitat, this deck inspires contemplation, empathy, & meaningful action to enact personal & planetary healing.

Many people feel called to some greater purpose in life but struggle to discover what that purpose is or even where to begin. Others know they have a gift but are unclear how to develop or articulate that gift. The 11 Spiritual Roles of the Soul, by celebrated author & channel Sara Landon, offers readers a profound & life-changing perspective on why we are here on Earth at this time.

In this book, The Council—an energetic presence of non-physical beings—reveals the 11 spiritual roles of the soul: healer, messenger, seer, transformer, dreamer, visualizer, wayshower, connector, uplifter, coder, & guide. 

After understanding their spiritual role, readers will learn:
• How the 11 spiritual roles relate to their life’s purpose
• How to use their spiritual gifts to enhance & expand every area of their lives
• Why stepping into their spiritual role right now is so important
• How they fit into the Great Awakening of humanity occurring at this time
• Daily practices for embodying their spiritual roles

By aligning with their spiritual roles, individuals can uncover their true purpose, develop confidence in their unique gifts, & navigate their path with renewed clarity & joy.

In his million-copy bestseller, THE 80/20 PRINCIPLE, Richard Koch showed readers how to take advantage of the simple fact that 80% of your results come from 20% of your efforts. In 80/20 BELIEFS, he shows how just a few core beliefs - often unconscious yet profoundly influential - shape our lives, happiness & success.

By identifying & examining the 'toxic' beliefs that cause unnecessary stress & shaping them into good beliefs that foster resilience & joy, we can enjoy a life of greater fulfilment.

“Time is money,” as the saying goes, but most of us never feel we have enough of either. In Master Your Time, Master Your Life, internationally acclaimed productivity expert & bestselling author Brian Tracy presents a brilliant new approach to time management that will help you gain control of your time & accomplish far more, faster & more easily than you ever thought possible.

Drawing on the latest research in productivity science & Tracy’s decades of expertise, this breakthrough program allocates time into ten categories of priority—including strategic planning/goal setting, people & family, income improvement, rest/relaxation, & even creative time—and reveals the best techniques for focusing on each effectively. By thoughtfully applying the principles in Master Your Time, Master Your Life, you’ll not only achieve greater results & reach your goals more quickly & successfully, you’ll also have more time to devote to what you truly love.

There is a huge disconnect, Dr. Sonya explains, between how women are feeling in their minds & bodies & how they are treated in today’s medical system. They are told things like “it’s a part of aging,” “you just need to get out more,” or the best, “there’s nothing I can do but here’s an antidepressant.” Perimenopausal women in particular are told that the stage they are in doesn’t even exist, despite the multitude of symptoms they experience every single day. Women turn to influencers & Dr. Google to solve their health problems but don’t know how to navigate all the noise. They feel unheard, unsafe, undervalued, stretched to the max, & most of all, alone.

Until now. After treating patients in her Divine Elements Health Center for more than 15 years, conducting thousands of hormone tests & treatment protocols, leading women’s circles & yoga retreats, apprenticing with an OBGYN, studying the shamanic medicine wheel, & traveling a continuously evolving path of self-discovery, Dr. Sonya has identified the missing link in the realm of women’s health: how your everyday moments, emotions, & relationships are influenced by the health of your hormones.  

In this book, she unpacks this profound connection, then outlines her signature HER Method (Hormonal-Emotional-Relational) of healing, which includes:
• A breakdown of the hierarchy of hormonal healing • In-the-moment techniques to relieve suffering & deepen connection • Practices to bring you back in sync with your body, drawn from

A bedside journal for better sleep from a board-certified doctor, featuring proven, faith-informed tactics & soothing devotions for those who struggle with falling asleep.

Sleep Habits is a comforting companion from someone who understands your sleep frustrations & invites you on a journey toward better sleep & overall well-being. Board-certified sleep doctor Benjamin Long offers hope for anyone who needs help falling asleep or quieting the anxieties of the day while longing for rest. 

In addition to brief biblical devotions, this guided journal also features:
• Tips & simple exercises for getting a good night’s sleep
• Soothing & encouraging verses
• Prayers for sleep
• Habit trackers
• Questions & reflection prompts

Organised according to the Sleepless Night Rules, Sleep Habits Journal will equip you with practical tools inspired by CBT-I to improve your sleep quality. Whatever your nights look like, may this guided journal invite you into experiencing more peace, rest, & comfort.

Who has not experienced a dog who just won’t stop barking or a cat that seems to strike out without apparent reason? Relief might be at hand with the simple yet effective point-tapping practices of the Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT), which provide an excellent hands-on tool for treating behavioural, emotional, & health challenges in animals.

In this practical guide, expert animal communicator & healer Joan Ranquet shows how to apply this energetic bodywork method on animals such as dogs, cats, or horses. As you tap on certain acupressure points with a specific intention in mind, the animal will experience energetic release on the levels of mind, body, emotions, & spirit. For easy access, you will find maps clearly illustrating the specific EFT acupressure points on dogs, cats, & horses. In addition, Joan provides sample point sequences & intention scripts geared to specific ailments, conditions, & behavioural challenges, as well as end-of-life care. Targeted to work with & relieve difficult emotions, the points used in EFT sequences each have a feel-good aspect to them, either a calming or releasing effect, & the scripts work to help break up old behavioural or emotional patterning.

Presenting a way to cut straight to the energetic source of the problems the animal experiences & provide relief even if you don’t know the cause of their pain, this guide will help you not only become closer to your animal companions but also improve their well-being as well as your own.

We all want to be happier, but our brains often get in the way. When we’re too stuck in our heads, we obsess over our inadequacies, compare ourselves with others & fail to see the good in our lives.

In The Science of Happiness, world-leading psychologist & happiness expert Bruce Hood demonstrates that the key to happiness is not self-care but connection. He presents seven simple but life-changing lessons to break negative thought patterns & reconnect with the things that really matter.

• Alter Your Ego
• Avoid Isolation
• Reject Negative Comparisons
• Become More Optimistic
• Control Your Attention
• Connect With Others
• Get Out of Your Own Head

Grounded in decades of studies in neuroscience & developmental psychology, this book tells a radical new story about the roots of wellbeing & the obstacles that lie in our path. With clear, practical takeaways throughout, Professor Hood demonstrates how we can all harness the findings of this science to rewire our thinking & transform our lives.

• Shows the role water deficiency plays in a large number of diseases & other health disorders
• Explains how to determine the quality & quantity of water that is best for you & the time during the day it is best to drink
• Includes 10 water cures for profound physical rehydration, toxin removal, & remineralisation

Drinking sufficient quantities of water is a necessity for optimal physical functioning, but it can also play a major role in the prevention & treatment of many diseases. Chronic fatigue, depression, eczema, rheumatism, gastric disorders, high or low blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, & urinary infections are but a few of the many disorders that can result from not drinking enough water—and which can be treated by raising our intake of this vital liquid.

The physical assaults that our bodies endure from pollution, stress, overly rich & processed foods (often containing too much salt), & alcohol & tobacco have dramatically increased our daily need for water over what our ancestors required. Christopher Vasey explains not only why water is so essential to our health but also what quantities we should drink & when. He also discusses the qualities of different types of water & demonstrates which will best address certain conditions. In addition, he provides 10 water cures that will rehydrate the deepest levels of the body, remove toxins, & restore vital minerals.

featured_reviews.name: Siddharth Naidu
featured_reviews.review_text:
A LANGUAGE OF UNKNOWN

They stood there, locked in a quiet battle of words, the young man brimming with an almost childlike enthusiasm, trying to justify yet another book purchase as if the turning of the calendar was some grand occasion...His companion, half amused, half exasperated, reminded him of the small fortune he had already spent, her voice carrying the gentle authority of someone who knew his habits too well...He clung to a Batman comic like a talisman, only for her to sigh wasn’t two enough? As if the world of Batman could ever be contained in mere numbers...Their conversation wove through genres, shifting from playful to passionate, the air between them charged with something deeper than books a shared language, a quiet understanding and giggles...I stood there, an unnoticed observer, drawn into their orbit, watching love manifest not in grand gestures but in the simple intimacy of knowing each other’s obsessions and spending time quality time...Perhaps I should move along, leave them to their world, but for a moment, it was enough just to witness,just to admire...

featured_reviews.name: Kusal Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Tucked away in an aesthetic corner of South Bombay, this bookstore is a true haven for book lovers. With its charming atmosphere and thoughtfully curated shelves, it offers an impressive range of genres that caters to every kind of reader. Whether you’re hunting for a classic, exploring contemporary fiction, or diving into niche subjects, this place makes browsing feel like an experience rather than just a visit. A must-stop spot for any book nerd wandering through the city.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Bishnoi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ashish Book Centre, tucked away near the bustling CSMT Railway Station in Fort, is nothing short of a paradise for true book lovers. In a city that’s always racing against time, this bookstore feels like a quiet, timeless refuge where stories patiently wait to be discovered.

What makes Ashish Book Centre truly special is its incredible collection. From rare second-hand classics and academic textbooks to novels, competitive exam guides, and out-of-print treasures—you never know what gem you’ll stumble upon. Browsing through the shelves feels like going on a literary treasure hunt, and every visit brings a new surprise.

The owners and staff are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They don’t just sell books; they understand them. Whether you walk in with a specific title in mind or just a vague idea of what you want to read, they guide you with genuine enthusiasm and honesty. Their passion for books is infectious.

Another big win is the affordability. Ashish Book Centre proves that great reading doesn’t have to be expensive. Students, avid readers, and collectors alike will appreciate the fair pricing and excellent condition of the books.

Located in the heart of Fort, just a stone’s throw from CSMT, it’s incredibly convenient and perfectly placed for a spontaneous visit after work or college. Despite the chaos outside, the store offers a calm, almost nostalgic vibe that reminds you why physical bookstores still matter.

If you love books, value knowledge, or simply enjoy the charm of old-school bookstores, Ashish Book Centre is an absolute must-visit. It’s not just a shop—it’s an experience, a legacy, and a reminder that the love for reading is very much alive in Mumbai. 📚

featured_reviews.name: Rixon Monteiro
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is truly a hidden gem. In a world where kids are glued to screens, you really need something more engaging than screens to grab their attention and this place has it..... Books! Not just any books; curated, colorful, engaging, "based on real life experiences" books. We were greeted by their very passionate staff and the owner Sangeeta who were excited to see us. I learnt more about storytelling in 5 minutes with Sangeeta than I did in my life. We thought we would buy just a couple of books and leave but after we entered and saw their collection, we left with 15 books (and we stopped coz our baggage allowance on our flight back home wouldn't allow more..lol). Can't wait to be back here soon.

featured_reviews.name: Mallika Jamy
featured_reviews.review_text:
A book is a dream that you hold in your hands.

My happy place is a book store, library or even a street vendor selling books. Came across a new place - Kahani tree 🌳.
Turned into a little kid filling my bag with books to buy and read. My son was all excited and showed interst in many new topics. A very good collections of Indian and International tiles, English and bi-lingual books too. 📚.
Very helpful staff and wonderland for kids.
Do call and visit.

featured_reviews.name: Amrita K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Everything a book lover could ask for- Cozy corners, comforting books and the sweetest owner, Ms Sangeeta. It’s a child’s paradise. A wide genre of children’s books, Indian authors & international publishers . My kids loved spending their Sunday immersed in stories galore. Not to forget, they have the kindest staff who are so good with the children .
Easily one of our most favourite places in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
In Mumbai, you might want to skip a visit to marine drive and enter this amazing world of books - Kahani Tree, specifically curated for children aged 0 years to 13 years by Sangeeta Bhansali.

India has amazing child authors but in prominent stores you won’t find their books. Kahani Tree allows you to connect with the thoughts of these amazing child authors by showcasing their books and allowing you to purchase them at a very reasonable price.

featured_reviews.name: Tasneem Khairullah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally made it to Kahani Tree today..
It was on my "To do list" last trip to India but did not happen then.
Spacious place, well lit, well stacked books for children. If you want to encourage your child to read a definite place to visit.
I chose Indian authors with a desi flavour to take back home with me for my grand daughter.
Who is currently 9 months old and already gets read to and loves seeing colorful books..
Staff were very helpful!
Absolute pleasure to visit.

review_photos.caption:
Demo of reading to your little ones. Such a fun place to be! 
My kids were both avid readers. I think my grand daughter will follow..

featured_reviews.name: Shilpa Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text: Loved every thing about Kahani Tree, the collection of books, the way the books are displayed, the lovely look and feel of the place, the warmth of each team member! I wish Kahani tree was a library along with being a book store! Would certainly recommend Kahani Tree for all book enthusiast children and parents

featured_reviews.name: CVK
featured_reviews.review_text: A truly delightful and cosy children's book store tucked away in the heart of Mumbai in Century Bazaar. They have the most incredible collections of children's books I've seen in India with plenty of Indian language books. Inspired by the store owner's goal is not just selling books but inspiring kids to live to read!!

featured_reviews.name: Hemang Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Eons ago I had no money to buy expensive CS books so I used to go visit the store. Stand inside and read books. Thought myself a lot and whatever I achieved in CS was partly thanks to Sterling Book store.
I must have read 8-10 text books cover to cover in various CS related subjects and it was helpful. Obviously I never bought a book but I am eternally greatful to the staff in allowing me to educate myself.

featured_reviews.name: karthik venkatesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was searching for a good CX-3 flight computer calculator, and many of my friends recommended Stirling Bookhouse. Based on their suggestion, I placed an order for the CX-3 on the 25th of September, and to my surprise, it got delivered by the 27th of September.

The delivery was super fast and smooth, without any hassle. The CX-3 calculator I received was brand new, perfectly packed, and working flawlessly. I’m really impressed with the quality and the professionalism in their service.

I am very happy with my experience and would definitely recommend Stirling Bookhouse to anyone looking for aviation supplies or books. Their service is reliable, and they truly live up to the recommendations I got from my friends.

featured_reviews.name: Anant
featured_reviews.review_text: I perfect model with A321 Neo 1:400 of Indigo beautiful made and fantastic.  Sterling has been a old friend team of all Captains since ages of India itself. They were very with quick support always. Wonderful with their Team and the Models as well.

featured_reviews.name: ARQAM
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely poor and student-unfriendly experience. I bought ACCA books worth ₹12,000 and returned to the store within just 4 days with the books completely unused and in perfect condition. Despite this, the staff flatly refused any return, exchange, or store credit.

The shop shows zero concern for students spending large amounts on professional courses. They rely entirely on a rigid “no return” line instead of basic customer fairness. No support and no empathy.

I strongly warn that : double-check everything before buying, because once they take your money, they take no responsibility.

featured_reviews.name: Bishal Mandal
featured_reviews.review_text: I had ordered 'The Aviator's Handbook, 5th Edition' by Cdr. Thomas Tom from Sterling Book House via SpeedPost and had received my shipment on-time. First of all, I got 10% discount and free shipping offer from Sterling Book House. Making payment online was also very easy, fast, secure and hassle-free. Secondly, I got my Invoice & shipment tracking information all in my email. At the same time, they provided real time support to me over WhatsApp regarding shipment status. And thirdly, when I received my parcel safely then it was very well packed with brown cardboard and plastic sheet. The book was also in very good condition. My whole experience with Sterling Book House was really excellent and fulfilling. Based on my experience with Sterling Book House, I will definitely order more and more aviation books from them in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Sujal Solia
featured_reviews.review_text: They sell dirty & damaged books and don't exchange it for another, dont buy from here order online

featured_reviews.name: Manjiri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a CX-3 flight computer from Sterling Book House in Mumbai, and I’m beyond impressed with their service. The delivery was incredibly quick—I received my order the very next day! On top of that, the price was significantly lower compared to Amazon and other online stores, which was a big plus.

The product arrived in perfect condition, well-packaged, and exactly as described. It’s clear that they value their customers and ensure a smooth shopping experience.

If you’re looking for aviation supplies or books, I highly recommend Sterling Book House. Their combination of quick delivery, competitive pricing, and excellent service makes them stand out.
